reviewer: Codex independent architecture and budget reviewer

replay_recommendation.approach: A new explicit three-stage completed-run replayer with injected prompt builder and observer, without changing frozen modules or monkeypatching their globals.
completed_run_requirements: Exact expected pilot inventory and three contiguous settled attempts per run
Current source pins and retained source bytes match
SQLite state equals the retained budget snapshot
Reconstructed prompt, wire, raw receipt and verdict bindings match
Token and cost holds, reported resources, stage identity and elapsed times agree
Terminal context, counts and shared limits agree
replay_recommendation.partial_run_policy: Explicitly refuse to label a pending or partial run as completed replay. Retain all pending artifacts and require separate reconciliation; no retry or new pilot budget follows uncertainty.

pre_dispatch_review_requirements: Freeze exact stage role, order, identity, output ceilings and decoding in versioned source
Carry only a schema-valid stage-2 workpad belonging to the same pilot and run
Keep control response and control verdict out of workpad and final requests
Invalid workpads remain absent and cannot crash final rendering
Validate the exact role-specific binding inventory and types before unchanged original finite CHECKS
Reject missing, extra, duplicate, cross-carrier and wrong-stage bindings
Verify actual wire decoding and output ceilings against saved requests and receipts
Check pre-dispatch cap refusal and missing usage/cost fail-closed retention
Reject duplicate pilot selections before spending and prevent run reuse
Freeze source and prompt recipes before provider dispatch
interpretation_limits: The simplification changes a contract bundle; historical improvements do not isolate a single ingredient.
A single-shot control and two-call treatment use different call and time allocations.
Only visible public calculation records are requested; no hidden reasoning channel is inspected.
Finite witness acceptance is separate from analytical completion and learning admission.
This receipt reviews pre-dispatch code and offline payloads; it does not claim any new live result or mathematical completion.

addressed_findings.finding: The first implementation read the nonexistent prompt user key and could not produce preflight.json.
addressed_findings.resolution: Changed the UTF-8 byte metric to prompt.user_prompt; independently inspected the corrected implementation before source freeze.

completed_review: Read all three new runtime modules, the numbered role/recipe/registry files, and the experiment spec.
Compiled all 15 base prompt instances; reviewed shared exact fragments and every task/stage difference, plus valid/missing-workpad behavior.
Confirmed exact seed retention, the full disputed pilot-201 source excerpt, explicit conditional system licenses and stage-specific output contracts.
Confirmed same-pilot/same-run workpad validation and isolation of control output and verdict from treatment requests.
Confirmed shared durable reservations and hard deadlines use the existing frozen adapter without additional attempts or transport duplication.

Confirmed complete-run replay binds current and retained source bytes, canonical request, raw reply, typed attempt resources, SQLite state, stages, contexts, terminal counts and original finite checks.
Confirmed prepare is network-free, includes the spec in source pins, labels stage-3 previews as missing-workpad cases and run refuses source drift before catalog discovery.
